subject: Post-call: next steps and demo availability (security + procurement intake)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: next steps and demo availability (security + procurement intake)

Hi Alex — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everything's written down:

- Goal: show a short technical deep dive/demo that demonstrates multi-tenant latency profiles and SSO onboarding flow.
- Attendees we recommend: your platform lead + procurement + security. From our side: myself (sales), Marissa (solutions), and Kar_tik (platform) can join.

For logistics, can you confirm who on your side will own procurement and security conversations? That will help us bring the right SMEs. I attached our SOC2 intake and a one-page mutual-action-plan draft for procurement to review.

Here are three 60-minute slots (PST) we have open next week — pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda:
1) Tue Jun 1, 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed Jun 2, 14:00–15:00 PT
3) Thu Jun 3, 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of those work, share two windows that do and we’ll adapt. Also note: we plan to cover SSO/SCIM, deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated), and expected billing/commit path for Dedicated.

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (fill what you can), mutual-action-plan.pdf (draft), demo-deck-v1.pdf

Thanks — I’ll loop Kar_tik and Mina from platform/security once you confirm stakeholders.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Harper <alex@brightgrid.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.m@brightgrid.com>, Evan Ross <evan.ross@brightgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps and demo availability (security + procurement intake)

Hi Mateo — thanks for the summary and the materials. Priya is procurement lead (cc'd) and Evan is our security architect (cc'd). Both will want to see the SOC2 questionnaire and the MAP.

We can do Wed Jun 2, 14:00–15:00 PT (option 2). A couple of asks up front so we can pre-read:
- Can you include a brief note on how token billing maps to committed capacity for Dedicated?
- Does Redwood support SSO + SCIM out of the box or is that a custom integration? Evan will want to know details.

If you can drop a calendar invite for that slot and include any short pre-reads, we’ll accept.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the demo.

—Alex
Alex Harper
Head of Platform Engineering\BrightGrid Systems
alex@brightgrid.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex@brightgrid.com>, Priya Malhotra <priya.m@brightgrid.com>, Evan Ross <evan.ross@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: next steps and demo availability (security + procurement intake)

Thanks Alex — slot confirmed. I’ve created a calendar event and included a short agenda and pre-read links. Forwarding the details below and attaching the updated MAP that calls out timelines for procurement and committed capacity.

Agenda (60m):
- 5m intro & success criteria (Alex + Mateo)
- 20m platform demo (Karthik) — multi-tenant perf and KV-cache behavior
- 15m SSO/SCIM & infra integration (Mina + Karthik)
- 15m procurement path & Q/A (Marissa)

Pre-reads: demo-deck-v1.pdf (attached), brief notes on token/commit mapping: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDemoMaterials

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-brg-4591 (please accept)

Procurement note: Marissa — I’ll push the MAP and an itemized cost example for a 6-month Dedicated commit to the HubSpot deal. Priya, if you can flag any must-have procurement approvals, we’ll surface them early.

Security note: Mina, Evan — quick heads up: Evan asked about SCIM and SSO; we support OIDC/SAML SSO out of the box and have a SCIM sync add-on that our platform team will demo. I’ll send a short technical note in a follow-up thread.

Attachments: updated-mutual-action-plan.pdf, demo-deck-v1.pdf

Best,
Mateo

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: next steps and demo availability (security + procurement intake)

Perfect — calendar invite accepted for Wed Jun 2, 14:00–15:00 PT. Priya and Evan will join. Evan: we’ll want the SCIM details ahead of time if possible, but this agenda looks good.

See you Wednesday.

—Alex
